Before payment

Read the full booking and payment sequence

One repeated concern includes a working understanding of the pattern, what may be worth observing or investigating, one practical response to try, and a concise written next-step summary. The Founder reviews suitability, capacity and availability, then gives explicit written permission before payment. Local clients receive bank transfer or DuitNow QR details; international clients receive Wise bank transfer details. Payment details are sent privately. Send payment proof through the private channel provided. The Founder verifies payment before confirming the booking manually. A request, payment or proof is not automatic booking confirmation.

Turn autism advice into a practical home plan you can actually use. Prioritise the most important concern, build a personalised Home Support Plan, use implementation guidance, review what happened and adjust the plan based on your family’s experience. One check-in about a month after the final session.

One step at a time.

  1. 01

    Notice

    Look at what happens before, during and after a difficult moment.

  2. 02

    Try

    Choose one manageable change that fits your family’s routine.

  3. 03

    Review

    In ongoing support, look at what happened and adjust together.
